items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: 21 files in upstream's Apache-2.0 tree carry the reworded NVIDIA proprietary notice ('NVIDIA CORPORATION, its affiliates and licensors retain all intellectual property'), including the shipped header src/cvcuda/include/cvcuda/Version.h, cmake/, and docs/design/ files. Upstream self-inconsistency (NVIDIA dual-stamping its own repo); a person should rule the tier standing for our fork redistribution.

The port branch is not clang-format-14 clean: running the project's own pre-commit formatter over the 67-file port surface rewrites 619 lines (250 CvCudaHipCompat.h, 192 MathOps.hpp, 35 cusolverDn.h, rest alignment of upstream lines shifted by port #if blocks). Upstream's tree is not clean under the same binary either, so the hook is not a hard gate there. The four port-authored spots in this round's touched hunks were fixed in be328991; a person should rule whether to do the branch-wide whitespace sweep before PR #293 is re-reviewed.
